issues.description: Method SealSaloon.orderMeal(Meal): the problem statement (UML and textual API) declares orderMeal with return type void (see UML entry in problem_statement.md), but the reference implementation in solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/SealSaloon.java declares the method as public boolean orderMeal(Meal meal). This mismatch between the specified API and the solution's method signature can confuse students about the expected return type and may cause grading or compatibility problems (tests or teacher-provided code that expect a void method will not match a boolean-returning implementation).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method signature consistent between specification and implementation. Preferred fix: change the solution's method to match the problem statement (public void orderMeal(Meal meal)) and remove the boolean return values/returns. Alternatively, update the problem statement and UML to explicitly document a boolean return type and its semantics if the boolean return is intentional.
